cases.purpose: Observe private regular-file ioctl and descriptor-close error injection, later actions and shell descriptor identity using an owned nonroot guest tracee with observer-drained output pipes.
cases.oracle: Guest-only native controls record protected truncate and pipe-ftruncate denial, per-channel pwrite/lseek rejection, both errno classes, post-close EBADF, descriptor reuse and unregistered rejection. Incremental controls and the companion data-only gate assess each assertion separately; pidfd and kcmp only qualify open-description comparisons.
cases.comparison: Observation only; a separately reviewed controller teardown and protected-record witness is required before execution. The independent primary gate assesses pipe binding, per-channel sensitivity, stopped-writer drain barriers, protected per-run journals, exact delivery and per-assertion controls; generic runner status establishes no coverage.
